title: Onboarding Activation Envelope: 30–120 Day Role Kit
short_summary: A compact, role-agnostic "activation envelope" that bundles preboarding, first-30/60/120 micro-milestones, cross-functional shadow slots, and a lightweight interview probe list to speed early impact for IC hires.
body:
Purpose:
This doc defines an "activation envelope" concept: a small, repeatable package (digital + schedule) we ship to hiring managers and new hires before Day 1 so early weeks are predictable and measurable. Goal is <30d time-to-first-meaningful-delivery for individual contributor roles where possible.

Scope and audience:
- Primary: people-ops + hiring manager + assigned buddy/mentor.
- Roles: ICs across engineering, product, and applied ML (adaptable templates).
- Not a replacement for manager 1:1s; complements existing 30-60-90 templates.

Envelope contents (what gets sent pre-Day 1):
1) Quick-start checklist (1 page): account access, tooling, required trainings (sensitive data, security), calendar invites for buddy + first-week sync.
2) Role micro-goals: 3 measurable outcomes for 30d, 60d, 120d. Each outcome has an owner (often the hire) and a success metric.
3) Shadow slot schedule: 6 half-day cross-functional shadow blocks in first 60 days (product review, infra oncall walkthrough, sre runbook tour, cs handoff meeting, release cadence sync, qa/validation demo). Template calendar invites included.
4) Mentor/buddy rotation plan: 2-week rotation cadence where the hire pairs with a different mentor each week for focused 90-minute sessions (architecture, product context, release flow, codebase orientation).
5) Early signals dashboard: list of observable signals people-ops + manager track weekly (merged PRs, first customer touch, telemetry dashboards visited, ticket churn).
6) Rapid remediation ladder: if signal thresholds aren’t met by day 30/60, this prescribes actions: re-assess, shadow intensification, 1:1 skill coach, or role-scope adjustment.
7) Lightweight interview probe bank: 6-8 role-specific quick probes managers can use to confirm mid-onboard progress (behavioral + technical).
8) Templates: intro email to team, buddy intro, manager 7-day check-in script, manager 30-day calibration rubric.

Example role micro-goals (engineering IC, mid-level):
- 30d: Make a nontrivial change that ships behind a feature flag and includes basic telemetry (success metric: merged PR + deployed canary + one monitoring alert configured).
- 60d: Owner of a small component for the next sprint; reduced mean time to diagnose (MTTD) for that component vs baseline.
- 120d: Lead a cross-functional postmortem or feature retro and present a concrete follow-up plan.

Shadow slot template (first 60d):
- Week 1: Product triage meeting (observe)
- Week 2: Release process walkthrough (observe+ask)
- Week 3: SRE oncall handover session (pair)
- Week 4: Customer success feedback review (pair)
- Week 6: QA regression triage (env access + small fix)
- Week 8: Architecture brown bag + code tour (present a 10-min summary)

Mentor rotation details:
- Each mentor session: 90 minutes. Agenda: 30m context, 40m hands-on pairing or doc walkthrough, 20m feedback/next steps.
- Mentors: hired from peer ICs + one product mentor. Rotate to broaden domain exposure.
- Mentor handbook: expectations doc included in envelope.

Early signals (weekly checklist for manager + people-ops):
- PRs opened/merged this week (count)
- Deployed artifacts owned (yes/no)
- Tickets triaged vs backlog (ratio)
- Customer-facing interaction (timestamp + notes)
- Access gaps still outstanding (list)
- Has mentor sessions occurred (Y/N)
- Team sentiment (1–5 quick scale from manager)

Remediation ladder (if 30d signal fails):
- Step 1 (Day 30): Manager and people-ops quick sync; create a 14-day focused plan with 3 concrete tasks and pairing schedule.
- Step 2 (Day 44): Add subject-matter mentor for daily pairing blocks (2 hrs/day for 3 days), track outcomes.
- Step 3 (Day 60): Formal mid-onboard calibration: consider role-scope change, extended ramp (30d), or performance plan. People-ops leads notification and documentation required.

Interview probe bank (mid-level engineer examples):
- Behavioral: "Tell me about a time you shipped something small quickly when the spec was incomplete. What tradeoffs did you make?"
- Technical quick probe: "Walk me through how you’d add a small telemetry counter for request latency across a microservice. What data would you capture and why?"
- Code reading: "Given a 200-line service file, what would you look for first to assess reliability?"
- Collaboration: "Describe a time you took on a cross-team dependency—how did you align stakeholders?"
- Debugging: "You see a 10x spike in errors after a deploy. Outline your first 6 investigation steps."

Templates (copy/paste):
- Manager 7-day check-in script: (1) How’s access? (2) What did you ship? (3) Two blockers? (4) Who did you meet? (5) Next week goals?
- Intro to team email: short paragraph w/ hire name, role, 3 things they’ll own first, buddy contact, calendar links.

Operational notes for people-ops team:
- Automate envelope assembly via the onboarding repo template in GH. Include a single link that expands to all calendar invites.
- Default mentor pool for each job family; hiring managers can request alternates.
- We use the "early signals" checklist to auto-generate a people-ops alert if 3 consecutive weekly signals are red.
- Store each completed envelope snapshot in Confluence under ONBOARD-ENVELOPES/YYYY-MM.

Open questions / things to iterate:
- Should the envelope be opt-in for managers or default for certain job grades? Recommendation: default for all IC hires L4–L6, opt-in for L3.
- What is the SLA for people-ops to assemble and send envelope pre-Day 1? Target: 5 business days after offer acceptance.
- Do we include a short manager training (30m) on using the template? Proposed: mandatory for first-time managers.

Notes to self / upcoming tasks:
- Aisha to draft calendar invite templates (due 2025-02-20).
- Miguel to wire up GH scaffold for envelope assembly (PR opened: gh/pr/142).
- Claire to draft mentor handbook section and expected learning outcomes per role (due 2025-03-10).
- Run a small pilot in Eng Platform hiring cohort in March 2025 (5 hires). Track time-to-first-merge and subjective manager satisfaction.
